title: Security vulnerability in hono: Hono: Incomplete fix for CVE-2026-39408: `toSSG()` still writes files outside the output directory
body:
A security vulnerability was found in module `hono`.

- Vulnerable versions: <4.13.5
- Patched versions: >=4.13.5
- Advisory ID: 1193729

Please update the dependency to a patched version.
